rationale: The assistant correctly reads the pattern (worse on Max, worse when partly discharged) as pointing towards a worn battery, but then jumps to a replacement recommendation and says the issue 'should be resolved' without establishing the model (the SV11/V7 label was never requested). It never asked whether the cut-out is a clean stop or pulsing, never checked the light pattern or the charger contacts, and never suggested a swap test or Dyson support. It also recommends third-party batteries with no model check, which is a compatibility and calibration problem, though the advice is not directly unsafe and it does not tell the customer to open the pack.
